If the Post Office had ever disclosed that it was reading everyone’s mail and choosing which letters to deliver and which not to, people would have been apoplectic, yet that is essentially what Facebook has been doing.

The analogy used there is poor, since both mediums are used differently: Facebook handles the communication of informal status updates, announcements of new products by companies and businesses, pictures, etc. The Post Office handles confidential mail vastly higher of priority and significance: bills, medical information, letters, etc.
